purpose: Teach: 劣等/集権/旋回/発声/強大/果敢/残存/掟

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会的劣等感を抱える人の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered research on social inferiority complexes in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Slight lift at the end—genuine curiosity, not testing. Patient rhythm. The tone of a teacher who actually reads what students submit.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中央集権体制の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I covered the history of centralized government systems.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. A beat of hesitation before answering, as if catching himself mid-thought. Respectful but slightly guarded, aware the answer might not be what was expected.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦闘機の旋回戦術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered fighter aircraft combat tactics in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Same warmth, but with a gentler questioning lilt. Not accusatory—more like she's offering him space to clarify. Measured pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、声楽における発声法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I covered vocal techniques in classical singing.
lines.style: Slightly faster than before, like he's regrouping. The words come out steady but there's an undertone of internal correction. Not defensive, just... recalibrating.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 強大な国家を作り上げた指導者を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered research on leaders who built powerful nations in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but still measured. A touch more directness now—she's following a thread. Clear elocution. No judgment, just presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、果敢な戦士の行動分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I covered behavioral analysis of brave warriors.
lines.style: Steady answer, but with the ghost of someone choosing his words carefully. A micro-pause on the opening word. Sincere but slightly distracted, like his attention is elsewhere.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時の残存兵力研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered research on remaining military forces during wartime in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Same patient, observant quality. Slight elongation on the final word—she's waiting for something. Reflective but present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、暴力組織の掟の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I covered research on the codes of violent criminal organizations.
lines.style: Words come out carefully, almost deliberately. A quiet finality at the close. Respectful but firm. The tone of someone who knows what he's saying and accepts it.
